title: Chapter 672
text:
At the center of the base station, the base station commander was also observing Black Star's movements.

"Black Star is the only one who managed to break through the protective shield. Tamaria has already brought people to hold him back," an observer said.

The base station commander nodded. Looking at the battlefield radar, his pupils suddenly constricted.

"Hmm? The enemy sent out a Calamity Grade team to break through, and they're heading toward the satellite fortress where Black Star is? They want to reinforce Black Star. "

The base station commander's expression changed, and he spoke with a deep voice.

"Just in case, send another five Calamity Grade Supers to deal with Black Star. We cannot let the enemy destroy our satellite fortress. Once the base station loses its defenses, we will definitely lose!"

After the order was given, another five Calamity Grade Supers were dispatched.

The two sides had a tacit understanding and sent reinforcements to the battlefield where Black Star was.

…

In the air above the satellite fortress, the battle between Han Xiao and the Mech Legion against Tamaria's group of five had been going on for quite some time.

The battlefield spanned hundreds of miles. Everywhere they passed, the surface defenses of the fortress were torn apart by the Mech Legion.

The battle in the sky had already reached its climax.

Bang bang bang!

The five Calamity Grade Supers charged left and right, and the destroyed mechanical soldiers fell one after another.

Boom!

The dark gold mechanical axe spun like a whirlwind, bringing with it a thunderous sound wave as it smashed the machinery along the way. Tamaria's majestic strength drove her heavy armor, and she punched and kicked, smashing all the mechanical soldiers around her.

The other four displayed their various abilities, constantly killing the Mech Legion.

It looked like the enemy had activated Unparalleled Mode, but Tamaria's group of five was riddled with injuries. In reality, they were in an extremely passive state.

With millions of mechanical soldiers, the attacks were extremely concentrated, and there would definitely be a time when they would hit. Han Xiao had previously set up Philip's combat mode according to the trigger conditions of [Legendary Battle Technique]. The first two attacks were mainly to seal off the target's dodging paths, and the third attack would hit.

Furthermore, he had staggered the attack frequency of multiple troops and adopted a wave attack pattern. This meant that every round of attack from the entire army contained a large amount of True Damage, which was extremely lethal. This made the five of them feel even more pressure.

Tamaria did not even dare to take the attacks head-on anymore. Every time she faced a wave of attacks from the army, she could only focus on dealing with them. Otherwise, as long as she was hit by a wave of True Damage focused attacks, she would only be lightly injured due to luck.

Her face was filled with rage, and she kept cursing in her heart over and over again.

How could this not be considered lethal?!

Joad, you really are a f * cking scammer!

In front of a Calamity Grade Super, the defense of most of the cannon fodder mechanical soldiers was still very fragile. However, their attack power had already undergone a qualitative change.

In the past, most of the time, Han Xiao would use the Mech Legion to exhaust his opponents before personally going up to beat them up. However, at this moment, his opponents were completely trapped within the Mech Legion and were too tired to deal with him. They did not even have a chance to attack him.

Philip's calculation efficiency firmly controlled the situation of the battle, and Han Xiao was able to free up his hands to perform Virtual Intrusion. Surprisingly, the target was this satellite fortress.

The defensive measures of the satellite fortress were endless, and it held back half of his Mech Legion. In order to quickly destroy this satellite, Virtual Intrusion was the most efficient method.

Boom!

Right at this moment, Tamaria suddenly used some kind of ability and broke through the encirclement of the army with a blood-red shockwave. Like a cannonball, she shot right in front of Han Xiao and brazenly attacked him!

Ha!

With a roar, the mechanical axe chopped down again!

"Tsk!"

Han Xiao smirked, and he had no choice but to stop Virtual Intrusion and release two Psionic Shields to block this attack again!

Clang!

The blade of the axe was stuck in the middle of the shields. At this moment, the blade of the axe seemed to have a suction force, and the flames around Tamaria were sucked in like a vortex. The blade of the axe became redder and redder.

The next moment, a thick blood-red shockwave burst out from the blade of the axe!

Zero range hit!

Boom!

Han Xiao was hit hard and groaned. Just as he was about to retreat, Tamaria was faster. She used the chain at the end of the mechanical axe to wrap around Han Xiao's arm and pulled him back.

"I told you, you can't run!"

Tamaria roared and violently headbutted Han Xiao's head.

Dong!

Han Xiao was dizzy. Tamaria's strength was at least 2,000 points, and it was inevitable that she would be able to crush him with strength.

The thick shockwave passed through the shockwave module of the helmet, and it made his ears ring.

Tamaria was about to continue attacking, but Han Xiao suddenly left the Mountain Ape mechanical suit, and his physical body was exposed to the outside world. Not only did he not panic, but he even looked a little speechless.

"You … are asking for it!"

The next moment, Han Xiao did something that shocked Tamaria.

Not only did he not dodge, but he also wrapped his arms around Tamaria's thick waist and hugged her.

"You …"

Before Tamaria could react, she suddenly felt an extreme sense of danger. She suddenly understood something, and her whole body turned cold.

The Mech Legion all turned their cannons and aimed at Han Xiao in the center … and Tamaria who was being hugged tightly by him!

"Let go of me!"

Tamaria was shocked and quickly tried to use her strength to push Han Xiao away.

However, the Mountain Ape mechanical suit controlled by Phillip spat out dozens of compressed orbs, which turned into all sorts of traps and placed them around the two of them. There were electromagnetic absorption, gravity enhancement, space stabilization, and so on. They used all kinds of control traps to create a short two to three seconds of control time.

The two of them were rooted to the ground, almost unable to move. They became targets together.

Han Xiao leaned close to Tamaria's ear and laughed. "You've been fooled, right? I'm the bait."

"Do you want to blow yourself up too?" Tamaria only realized that Han Xiao had an indestructible body after she finished speaking. Anger and despair appeared on her face as she gritted her teeth. "Do you really think you won't die?"

"No, I'm still going to die."

Han Xiao blinked and said something that Tamaria did not understand.

"But I'm immune to True Damage."

The next moment, countless psionic cannons fired from all directions!

Boom!

The expanding explosion covered the two of them. The other four Calamity Grade Supers were shocked, and they ran away without caring about anything else.

The ball of light expanded to the extreme and exploded. The shockwave blew away all the debris in the surroundings, sweeping away the dust and clearing up the surroundings. It was like using an eraser to erase a piece of black.

The exploding ball of light turned into specks of light that fell like rain.

At the center of the explosion, Han Xiao was in high spirits. He summoned his mechanical suit and put it on again. Only then did he let go of the charred corpse in his hand and let it fall.

With [Steel Body] being immune to True Damage, he was able to recover his energy continuously. Through the conversion between energy and energy, he was able to replenish the amount of health that was lost from the explosion. Not only was he not injured, he even felt a little refreshed.

Oh, so it was because the Advanced Strengthened Life talent had stacked a few times. No wonder his body was so relaxed.

Han Xiao raised his brows.

Using himself as bait to control the enemy and then letting the Mech Legion focus fire on him. This was his trump card after obtaining the conversion between energy and energy. As long as the enemy did not know what was going on, they would fall into his trap. As long as he could control them, he would unleash a wave of focused fire.

He specialized in beating up iron dolls.

After obtaining [Legendary Battle Technique], the lethality of this battle style was completely different. It was already an ultimate move that could kill the enemy.

It could be said to be a blind fighting style!

Tamaria did not make a sound and was directly killed by the focused fire!

No matter what kind of person she was, in Han Xiao's eyes, she was just a Grade A + Pugilist with seventy percent of her health left. He would kill her in one move.

Whoever broke through would die!

Han Xiao turned around and looked at the other four Calamity Grade Supers not far away, grinning.

"Let's get closer to each other."

The four Calamity Grade Supers trembled, and their faces were filled with fear. They only had one thought left.
